categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai G.Tech Technology Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of computer peripheral products, focusing on keyboards and mice. Their product lines include business office series and esports gaming series, with offerings such as keyboards, mice, and keyboard-mouse sets. The company operates mainly in the computer peripherals industry under the category of computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced technologies such as Hall sensor-based magnetic axis keyboards, high-precision sensor technology for mice, and innovations in low power consumption and multi-functionality. It employs intelligent manufacturing systems including automated keyboard production lines, mold intelligent manufacturing systems, and integrates SAP, MES, and PDM systems with IoT technologies. Production follows an ODM model with customized design and manufacturing based on client specifications, focusing on automation, quality control, and flexible manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: G.Tech serves international well-known computer and peripheral brand manufacturers, primarily targeting the global market including Europe, North America, and Japan. Its products cater to end-users in esports gaming and high-end business office sectors. The company maintains long-term partnerships with leading global brands, providing customized solutions to meet diverse and evolving customer demands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province. It has a significant overseas production base in Vietnam (Vietnam G.Tech Technology Ltd.) to expand capacity and serve global customers. Its sales are predominantly international, with over 87% of revenue generated from overseas markets including Europe, North America, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: G.Tech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as an ODM manufacturer, responsible for product design, development, and manufacturing based on brand owners' requirements. It procures raw materials such as ICs, PCBs, switches, wires, and plastics, and delivers finished peripheral products to brand customers for final sale.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation with significant R&D investment focused on enhancing product performance, reducing power consumption, improving user experience, and integrating AI functionalities. Key R&D areas include magnetic axis keyboards, high-performance sensors, wireless technologies, ergonomic designs, and smart manufacturing automation. It also plans to expand product categories and deepen market penetration in esports and high-end business segments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales under an ODM business model, where G.Tech designs and manufactures customized computer peripherals for international brand customers who then market the products under their own brands. The company recognizes revenue at the point of product delivery and transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: G.Tech holds a leading position in the domestic ODM keyboard and mouse manufacturing sector with a strong reputation for quality, innovation, and efficient delivery. It competes with other established computer peripheral manufacturers in China and globally, leveraging its vertical integration, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and close cooperation with top international brands to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, G.Tech achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.32 billion, representing a 49% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 115 million, up 72%. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanded production capacity, increased sales volume, and enhanced R&D efforts. Total assets reached RMB 1.63 billion, with steady growth in net assets and profitability indicators.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: G.Tech differentiates itself through advanced R&D capabilities, high-quality manufacturing processes, and rapid responsiveness to customer needs. Its unique value lies in innovative technologies such as magnetic axis keyboards with Hall sensors, high-precision mouse sensors, and intelligent automated production lines. The company offers customized, high-performance peripherals tailored for esports and business users, supported by comprehensive quality certifications and global supply chain integration.
